blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea—North Korea fired at least one ballistic missile, Seoul’s military said Saturday after it blamed the North for an explosion in the Demilitarized Zone that wounded three South Korean soldiers. Seoul’s military demanded an official apology for the landmine blast, but Pyongyang has denied being responsible, calling South Korea “despicable.” Seoul and the US-led United Nations Command found that last month’s explosion inside the DMZ, the heavily mined buffer dividing the two Koreas since their 1953 armistice, was caused by North Korean mines laid on the South side of the border.
